Teri Hooper

Criminal Paralegal

Teri plays a vital role in supporting both our attorneys and clients throughout the legal process. In addition to ensuring that clients receive timely communication on their cases, Teri manages all filings related to criminal matters with precision and care and assists with trial preparation.
Teri has been with H&B since 2018 and has become an integral part of our practice, known for her professionalism, attention to detail, and compassionate approach. She holds a degree in marketing, bringing strong communication and organizational skills to her work. Outside of the office, Teri is a devoted spouse—married to her partner since 2008—and a proud parent of two children.
